question: In a certain code language, if PIZZA is coded as BAAJQ, BURGER is coded as SFHSVC, then what will NOODLES be coded as?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] **The logic followed here is:** (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally. So, • PIZZA is coded as BAAJQ
